build_ConvFCHead: build a ConvFCHead mask head with conv and FC layers to predict coarse masks from pooled features
build_PointRendMaskHead: build a PointRendMaskHead that combines coarse mask prediction with point-based refinement for instance segmentation
build_ImplicitPointRendMaskHead: build an ImplicitPointRendMaskHead that uses implicit neural representations with a parameter head for mask prediction
calculate_uncertainty: calculate uncertainty scores from mask logits by computing negative L1 distance to zero for foreground classes
run_PointRendMaskHead_forward: run the PointRendMaskHead forward pass to compute mask losses during training or subdivision inference during evaluation
